gen-gf-underdog-gf-mandali: Expressive and bold, Underdog keeps every curve at one thickness. Mandali follows with a sans-serif body whose e opens generously, so paragraphs feel approachable and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-meera-inimai: Underdog throws a wide horseshoe c and curves that never thicken or thin, all commanding and expressive. Meera Inimai's sans-serif lines have the same constant, blueprint-like line, with open-ended curves that give the display heading room to lead.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-metrophobic: Underdog's letters look bent from a single wire, with a horseshoe c that opens wide. And Metrophobic, a sans-serif body, glides smoothly around each bend, keeping the text modern and clean beneath it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-moderustic: Moderustic brings a contemporary sans voice, its curves traced with a broad nib and left open. Underdog above it looks cut from strips of equal width, so the heading stays loud and the text stays quietly modern.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-molengo: Molengo is a contemporary sans-serif with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp and tidy. Underdog earns its keep big and short, with no hairlines anywhere.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-mona-sans: Wide-mouthed and marker-drawn, Underdog looks traced with a single tip and opens its c like a horseshoe. Mona Sans, a plain sans, leaves its letter openings ajar like a door.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-monda: Chunky, bent-straw letters with a horseshoe c make Underdog hard to ignore. Monda, a plain sans, keeps its small counters unclogged, so a bigger heading size and modest text size would suit them.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-mooli: Mooli is a contemporary sans-serif with open, round letters that read clearly even at small sizes. Underdog's engraver-like cut, never deeper in places, gives the heading a firm, expressive presence above it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-murecho: Murecho reads modern and clean, its s curves opening wide at both ends in a plain sans. Underdog's total lack of calligraphic thinning is what makes the pairing so commanding.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-nanum-gothic: Underdog stamps out a single-weight stroke and a wide horseshoe c, built purely for expressive display. Nanum Gothic, a sans, does the quieter work, with wide channels leading into each counter.
